A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same COALA research work, with 28 readable pages including Appendices A–G. Text comparison and rendered-page inspection support reliable comparison of the equations, figures, tables, and supplementary material.

before.justification: v2 reports original timing, model-compression, and fine-tuning results in Tables 1–4, alongside numerical analyses including the convergence simulation in Appendix G.2.

after.justification: v3 retains the original empirical results in Tables 1–4 and the numerical analyses, including Appendix G.2.

M1.justification: The projection formula, QR/TSQR procedure, regularization, and fine-tuning initializations are unchanged. The revised assumption in Theorem 1 concerns its guarantee rather than the algorithm.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same WikiText2 and commonsense/knowledge benchmarks, compression and fine-tuning tasks, and numerical test scenarios. No training or evaluation coverage changes.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: SVD-LLM and SVD-LLM V2 in Table 1; ASVD and SVD-LLM in Table 2; FLAP, SliceGPT, SVD-LLM, and SoLA in Table 3; and LoRA, PiSSA, and CorDA in Table 4.

E3.justification: Experimental settings remain identical, including compression ratios, precision, metrics, model configurations, initialization samples, and training procedures in Sections 4–6 and Appendix F.

E4.justification: The numerical-stability analysis, regularization-scaling comparison, parameter-sensitivity analysis, and gap-dependent convergence simulation are retained without revision in Figures 1–6 and Appendix G.

E5.justification: Error-bar reporting in Tables 1–2 and the statistical-reporting checklist statement are unchanged. No run-count, seed, uncertainty-estimation, or significance-testing information is added or revised.

E6.justification: Tables 1–4 and Figures 1–6 retain identical numerical results and plotted findings, including the convergence experiment in Appendix G.2. No result entries or reported rankings change.

T1.justification: Theorem 1 removes v2's assumption rank(X) = k ≥ r while retaining the spectral-gap condition and the same convergence bound. This relaxes the full-column-rank restriction. The unchanged Appendix E proof already avoids that restriction, so this corrects the assumptions of an existing result.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions concerning numerical stability, regularization, memory efficiency, and convergence under limited data. Their claim scope is unchanged.

C2.justification: The convergence and gap-sensitivity interpretations in Section 5, experimental interpretations in Section 6, and applicability limitation in Section 7 remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendix F retains identical hyperparameters, hardware, software versions, training and evaluation times, and compression instructions. The reported code-access information is also unchanged.

R1.justification: Related-work discussion, citations, and bibliography are identical. Positioning relative to SVD-LLM, PiSSA, CorDA, and other prior methods does not change.

P1.justification: Theorem 1 receives a small wording adjustment accompanying the removed assumption, and the arXiv version/date stamp is updated. The remaining prose and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–6, Tables 1–5, and algorithm displays retain their structure, captions, styling, and placement. The document layout is retained.

improvement.justification: Removing the unnecessary full-column-rank hypothesis from Theorem 1 aligns its stated applicability with the existing Appendix E proof and discussion of general inputs. This improves theoretical consistency and precision; the method, empirical evidence, and remaining exposition are unchanged.
